infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Union listens on-device for screams, distress sounds, and your verbal safe-word to start a silent evidence recorder.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Union uses your photo library only to attach an optional guardian profile photo stored on this device.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Union uses your location only to attach GPS coordinates to a local emergency alert for your guardians.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Union to access your microphone for on-device scream, distress, and safe-word detection.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Union to attach an optional guardian profile photo stored on this device.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Union to use your location to include GPS in a local emergency alert for your guardians.
